Hi Helena, lovely to see you today. Here's a summary of what we covered so you have it in writing.

Diagnosis: mild Achilles tendinopathy in the right leg, probably from the sudden jump in mileage when you started training for the 10K. The tendon is irritated but there is no tear, which is good news.

Exercises: do heel raises on a step every day. Start with 3 sets of 12 reps, slowly up for 3 seconds and down for 3 seconds. If it feels more than 4 out of 10 pain, ease off for a couple of days. Please avoid hills, speed work and stretching the calf aggressively for now, as this can aggravate the tendon. Swimming and cycling are fine if they don't hurt.
